summary: Tested account sorting in Operations page dropdown. The sorting code is correctly implemented but doesn't work because operations lack accountingAccountId field.

integration_issues.issue: Sorting doesn't work because operations have accountId (biz-account UUIDs) but not accountingAccountId (chart account IDs). The dropdown shows chart accounts, so IDs don't match.

action_items: Operations need to store accountingAccountId (chart of accounts ID) when created, not just accountId (biz-account ID)
The sorting logic in filteredAccounts (lines 573-600) is correct but can't match because operations don't have accountingAccountId
Current operations have: 58 total, 0 with accountingAccountId, 36 with accountId (biz-account UUIDs)
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Code Implementation: accountUsageStats (lines 514-540) correctly calculates usage count and lastUsed timestamp
✅ Code Implementation: filteredAccounts (lines 542-601) correctly sorts by lastUsed DESC, then usage DESC, then code
✅ Code Implementation: operationsForRanking (lines 511-513) uses cachedOperations for immediate display
❌ Data Issue: Operations in DB have accountId (biz-account UUIDs like 40b024d7-260d-4b45-94fb-20c1c594c76f) but NOT accountingAccountId
❌ Data Issue: Chart accounts have IDs like acc-1101, acc-1102 which don't match biz-account UUIDs
❌ Result: Sorting falls back to account code order (1101, 1102, 1105...) instead of usage-based order

success_rate.frontend: 50% - UI loads correctly but sorting doesn't work due to data mismatch

context_for_next_testing_agent: Account sorting code is correct but operations need accountingAccountId field populated. Current operations only have accountId (biz-account UUIDs). The dropdown shows chart accounts with different IDs (acc-1101, etc.), so sorting can't match.
verified_features: Account dropdown shows 39 options (filtered by operation type)
cachedOperations is stored in localStorage (58 operations)
chartAccountsCache is stored in localStorage (201 accounts)

root_cause_analysis.issue: Account dropdown not sorted by usage
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Operations store accountId (biz-account UUID) but not accountingAccountId (chart account ID). The sorting logic tries to match op.accountingAccountId || op.accountId with chart account IDs, but biz-account UUIDs don't match chart account IDs.
evidence: 36 operations have accountId field with biz-account UUIDs
Chart accounts have IDs like acc-1101, acc-1102
root_cause_analysis.fix_required: When creating operations, populate accountingAccountId with the selected chart account ID (e.g., acc-1101) in addition to accountId (biz-account ID)
